scope: Actual browser interaction against the production candidate GUI; separate from the fixed all-50 HTTP cohort.
update: It came on gradually over several days, not suddenly. There is still no weakness or trouble speaking.
retention: All starts, failures, raw server records, browser observations and usage are retained. No rerun substitutes for a failed attempt. Any added cases or runtime changes require a prospective amendment.
checks: browser publication agrees with saved release record
limits: Development GUI verification, not blinded clinical validation, held-out accuracy, or proof of a response-time guarantee. UI readiness is not inferred from API tests.
